HDF.headline: Save about KES 29,500 in your first year
detail: That's about KES 90 a day.
About 1,450 fewer 500 ml plastic bottles a year.
It pays for itself in about 7 weeks.
Filtered water costs you about KES 7.20 a litre. About the same as a refill station, without the trip.
HDF.assumption: Estimate based on 2 litres a day, compared with the average price of bought water (KES 53.50 a litre: refill station from KES 7, 500 ml bottle KES 50, or KES 100 a litre). Your saving depends on how much you drink and where you would otherwise buy water. Delivery not included.
